selection: Each image visually inspected. Photo-led reactions, expressive faces, awkward scenes and funny animal photos; no quote panels, cartoon illustrations, text-heavy jokes or multi-panel collages. Small natural television subtitles, logos and occasional minor labels may remain.
provenance: Every image downloaded from Pinterest pinimg CDN, with a Pinterest pin or board source URL. Live candidates captured from the reference board and related recommendations.
deduplication: Perceptual difference and average hashes with similar aspect ratios
limitations: Pinterest source attribution does not verify creator identity or reuse license.
Perceptual checks cannot guarantee all reuploads or different crops have been found.
